title: Secrets
description: Passwords and API keys your agent's tools need, such as a web search key. Values are encrypted and can never be read back, only replaced.
usage: To let a tool use a secret, write its name in the benchmark settings (for example auth_env: TAVILY_API_KEY). Heimdall adds the value when the run starts and the agent never sees it. Each run gets only the secrets it names, on the worker that runs it.
agentUsage: An agent can use a secret directly too: in the agent settings, set a variable to {{ref}} and the run fills in the value (the agent can read it). If a run asks for a secret that does not exist here, it stops and names the missing one.
addDescription: Admins only. Paste the value once; after saving, only the name is shown.
name: Name
nameFormat: Use upper case letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter (max 64).
nameReserved: This name is reserved for the server. Pick another.
nameTaken: A secret with this name already exists. Rotate it instead.
valueTooLarge: The value is larger than 16 KiB.
saved: Saved {{name}}. Its value is now hidden for good.
empty: No secrets yet. Add one above so benchmarks that call outside services can run for real.
emptyViewer: No secrets yet. Ask an org admin to add one.
confirmDelete: Delete {{name}}? Runs that use it will fail until it is added again.
